title: Missing host setting leads to a cache lookup failure
root_cause: MANGROVE_CACHE_HOST is absent, so the probe falls back to an invalid hostname instead of the local service address. The later hostname lookup failure is a consequence of that missing variable.

relevant_evidence.why: The missing-variable message precedes the connection exception.
An absent value selects the invalid hostname before the connection attempt.
The service is published on host port 6435.
